title: Taiwan Dethrones Korea Atop World Markets as AI Trade Widens
key_facts: Taiex up 72% in 2026, top of more than 90 indices tracked by Bloomberg.
Kospi second with gains of about 65%.
Taiex beat Kospi by about 23 points last quarter, the widest margin since the turn of the century.
Samsung and SK Hynix shares fell 19% to 33% in the three months to September.
About 40% of fund managers in a Bank of America September survey were overweight Taiwan versus 25% for Korea.
Strategists say Korea's earnings come from memory prices, Taiwan's from volume across chip design, manufacturing, packaging, networking and servers.
quote_evidence: Up 72 per cent in 2026, Taiwan's benchmark is currently the top performer among more than 90 equity indices tracked by Bloomberg.
The Taiex Index beat the Kospi by about 23 percentage points last quarter, the widest margin since the turn of the century.
why_it_matters_hint: AI trade is broadening from memory chips to the full supply chain.
